==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Hé Chou:''' Long time no see, {{Rover}}.
:{{DIcon}} How have you been?
::'''Hé Chou:''' I've been doing much better lately, thanks for asking. The number of [[TD]] attacks has dropped, and the radar's been in top shape.
::'''Hé Chou:''' After I went back home that day, I gave it some thought, and ended up withdrewing my transfer letter.
:{{DIcon}} How are you still here?
::'''Hé Chou:''' After I went back home that day, I gave it some thought, and ended up withdrewing my transfer letter.
:{{DIcon}} You are...?
::'''Hé Chou:''' It's me, Hé Chou. Don't tell me you forgot about me already? We were on the radar repair job last time. I was the one that always had my head hanging...
::{{DIcon}} You've changed so much I almost didn't recognize you.
::'''Hé Chou:''' Yeah, after I went back home that day, I gave it some thought, and ended up withdrewing my transfer letter.
:'''Hé Chou:''' Now that I've decided to stay here, I can't be complaining all the time have to get my act together.
:'''Hé Chou:''' I mean, Qiuwang was able to develop such an amazing tech. I can't lose to him!
:{{DIcon}} How's Qiuwang?
:'''Hé Chou:''' After he made sure that everything were the way they should be, he moved on to the next place.
:'''Hé Chou:''' He mentioned there are still more data that needs to be collected, and even more advanced technologies that need to be researched...
:'''Hé Chou:''' From that moment on, I knew that someone like him is destined go even further along the path he had chosen... There’s nothing in this world that could stop him.
:'''Hé Chou:''' And my job is to safeguard the [[Desorock Highland]]s and fulfill my duties as a soldier.
:'''Hé Chou:''' That is the path I have chosen.
{{Dialogue End}}
